description.html: Arcadia EarthPro-Ca 100g is a pure calcium supplement without vitamin D3, with a calcium content of 39.4%. It is intended for daily use in reptiles that have adequate UVB lighting - under UVB light, animals synthesize vitamin D3 on their own, so they do not need extra.
Dust it over live or supplementary food before every feeding. Pure calcium without D3 is safe for daily use because it eliminates the risk of a vitamin D3 overdose.
Made in the United Kingdom by Arcadia Reptile, a brand known for its high standards in reptile equipment.
